title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
abstract: arXiv:2610.01260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy. translated_title: PROMO：面向四足机器人的偏好条件化多目标强化学习
translated_abstract: 四足运动需要在指令跟踪、稳定性与能效等相互冲突的目标之间取得平衡，然而传统的强化学习（RL）方法在训练时将这些优先级硬编码为固定的标量奖励。我们提出了PROMO（偏好条件化多目标强化学习），这是一种语义化的多目标方法，它将这种权衡作为单一运动策略在运行时的显式输入。PROMO以面向部署的偏好作为策略的条件，同时保持与机器人本体相关的运动先验固定不变，从而将操作者的意图与生成可行步态所需的奖励整形项分离开来。与固定目标控制器、多目标基线以及独立训练的专用策略相比，PROMO仅凭一个可部署的策略就实现了目标特化与鲁棒性。在仿真中对100个采样偏好进行测试，其中67种行为在精确的帕累托准则下是非支配的。
tldr: PROMO通过将部署偏好作为运行时的显式输入条件，实现了单一策略下四足机器人在指令跟踪、稳定性与能效等多目标之间的灵活权衡。
en_tdlr: PROMO enables a single deployable policy to flexibly trade off conflicting quadrupedal locomotion objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency by conditioning on explicit runtime preferences.
